title: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2610.16545v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at

translated_title: 启发式方法还不够：面向视频扩散加速的校准与纠错缓存
translated_abstract: 特征缓存已成为一种主流的无训练加速策略，通过在去噪步骤之间复用中间输出来加速视频扩散模型。然而，现有的自适应方法依赖于与实际生成质量不一致的启发式差异度量，采用忽略异构相位动态的单一全局阈值，并且从不将预算估计与真实近似误差进行验证，使得系统性偏差未经纠正地传播。我们提出了AlignCache，这是一个闭环缓存框架，通过三个紧密耦合的组件，将缓存调度决策与其对最终生成视频的真实影响直接对齐：(1) 相位自适应预算路由，将去噪轨迹划分为结构上不同的相位，每个相位由独立的阈值和陈旧性感知保护机制控制；(2) 闭环阈值校准，利用反事实误差测量……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: AlignCache是一个闭环缓存框架，通过相位自适应预算路由、闭环阈值校准和误差纠正机制，将视频扩散模型的缓存调度决策与最终生成质量直接对齐，从而实现更准确的加速。
en_tdlr: AlignCache is a closed-loop caching framework that aligns caching scheduling decisions with true generation quality in video diffusion models through phase-adaptive budget routing, closed-loop threshold calibration, and error correction, enabling more accurate acceleration.
